index.mission: I distill the internet that was left behind and turn it into code amulets.

manifesto.heading: Manifesto
manifesto.body: I don't create interfaces. I distill the internet that was left behind and turn it into code amulets. Every pixel is a symbol. Every bug, an enchantment.

lab.heading: Lab
lab.body: This is the space where experiments take shape. Tools, rituals, and artefacts under construction — fragments of digital magic still being distilled.
